title: Spanish Baked Eggs
description: A simple and flavorful breakfast dish where eggs are baked in a spicy Spanish-inspired mixture of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Cut the bread into cubes and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, garlic, chili flakes, and a pinch of salt.
Add the roasted red peppers, tomatoes, olives, and shredded cheese to the bowl.
Pour the egg mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange the toasted bread on top of the egg mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the bread is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
